A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gluon distribution in the proton can only be obtained from the electroproduction of charmonium states and the electroproduction of charm quarks.

at HERA, the gluon distribution in the proton can only be determined from the measurement of the charm cross sections if the charm production mechanism is well understood.
